title: Monitoring stack: Prometheus, rules and every Grafana panel
proves: Real API, worker and probe expose /metrics; a private Prometheus (v2.55.0) scrapes them with the repo's own prometheus.yml and rule files; all targets are UP, no rule has health=err, every Grafana (11.3.0) dashboard loads and the query of every panel runs without error against live data.
doesNotProve: Alert delivery (no Alertmanager), the web server job (not started), behaviour under production load, panels that need authenticated sockets, 5xx errors or release history (see expected-empty-panels.json).
